selection.decision: Nicolas approved the softer, gently brightened lip-pop derivative after Telegram audition.

model.name: Stable Audio 3 Small SFX
model.prompt: One isolated playful bubble-popping sound performed only with relaxed human lips: a soft rounded bilabial bwoop-plop, slightly wet and airy, like imitating a chewing-gum bubble popping. No speech or vocalization. Close dry studio recording, exactly one lip pop, no room sound.
model.negativePrompt: speech, word, voice line, tongue click, finger snap, hard tick, ceramic, glass, gunshot, firecracker, balloon bang, multiple pops, repeated sounds, long reverberation, background noise

licensing.distributionCategory: Generated WAV output only; model weights and runtime are not distributed with Menagerie.
